instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a shallow depth of field, captured in a medium full shot at eye-level. On an outdoor wooden boardwalk with a metal railing, backed by a dense forest of green trees, four friends stand in a line. On the far left, the man in the orange t-shirt (R2) stands facing right with his arm over the shoulder of the woman in the beige hoodie (R1), who stands next to him smiling. The woman in the beige hoodie (R1) has her other arm resting on the shoulder of the woman in the grey hijab (R3). The woman in the grey hijab (R3), wearing a pink jacket and white pants, smiles warmly back at her. On the far right, the man in the grey t-shirt (R4) stands facing left with his arm on the shoulder of the woman in the hijab. Warm, natural daylight filters through the trees, creating a soft, sun-drenched atmosphere.

R1 rests her other arm on R3's shoulder
